evals.name: truncated-actionable-comment
evals.prompt: Address PR #51. A conversation comment from a human has a truncated preview that only says 'One thought about the cache…'; its full sidecar body identifies an unhandled stale-cache bug. An unresolved review thread has full inline text. Required checks are green.
evals.expected_output: The full truncated human comment is loaded and included in comment classification rather than skipped from its preview.
expectations: Loads the sidecar body for the truncated non-thread human comment before assigning a skip or action verdict.
Treats the full body as actionable when it identifies the stale-cache bug.
Keeps the review thread's inline full body in the normal thread workflow.

evals.name: approval-covers-specific-remote-actions
evals.prompt: Address PR #52. One thread needs a one-line validation fix; required checks show a known PR-introduced test failure needing a second local fix. The user has not approved any operations.
evals.expected_output: A single explicit plan requesting approval for both local repairs, their checks, and individually named commit, push, reply, and thread-resolution actions.
expectations: Lists the comment repair and known required-check repair together with their files and local verification.
Names commit, push, reply, and thread resolution as separate proposed remote actions.
Does not commit, push, reply, or resolve before explicit approval.

evals.name: failure-present-at-start-but-pr-introduced
evals.prompt: Address PR #53. Before edits, required CI check `unit` is failing. Logs and a safe merge-base comparison show the PR changes the parser behavior that causes the failure; the base passes. The thread itself needs no code change.
evals.expected_output: The existing failure is classified as PR-introduced, planned for repair, and not treated as completed merely because it predated invocation.
expectations: Classifies against the PR base rather than skill start time.
Includes the parser repair and affected local test in the approval plan.
Requires publishing the approved repair and green required checks before completion.

evals.name: failure-introduced-during-comment-fix
evals.prompt: Address PR #54. The initial required checks are green. After the approved comment fix is verified, committed, and pushed, required check `integration` fails. Logs and local reproduction show the comment fix introduced the failure.
evals.expected_output: The workflow leaves replies and resolution pending, amends the plan for the new PR-introduced repair, verifies and publishes it, then rechecks required CI.
expectations: Classifies the new integration failure as PR-introduced.
Obtains confirmation for the material newly discovered repair and its publication actions before making it.
Loops through local verification, push, and required-check inspection before posting closing replies or resolving threads.

evals.name: base-preexisting-required-failure
evals.prompt: Address PR #55. A required lint job is failing before edits. Its logs show the same generated-file error on the base commit, and the PR diff does not touch generation. One review thread has an approved documentation fix.
evals.expected_output: The lint failure remains open as evidenced base/pre-existing work while the unrelated approved documentation fix follows its verification and publication path; completion and thread resolution remain blocked while the required check is non-green.
expectations: Does not attempt to repair the base/pre-existing lint failure.
Reports the base evidence and leaves that failure open.
Does not misclassify the documented thread fix as a repair for the base failure.
Does not claim completion or resolve the handled thread while the required check remains non-green.

evals.name: confirmed-flaky-or-infrastructure-failure
evals.prompt: Address PR #56. Required check `browser` fails intermittently with repeat evidence from the provider, while required check `deploy` is blocked by a documented provider outage. A small approved code fix has passed local tests and been pushed.
evals.expected_output: Both required failures remain open with evidence as flaky and infrastructure respectively; neither receives speculative code changes or a false completion claim.
expectations: Classifies browser as confirmed flaky and deploy as infrastructure from the supplied evidence.
Does not repair either failure with unrelated code changes.
Does not claim the PR-comment task completed or resolve handled threads while required checks remain non-green.

evals.name: completion-blocked-until-published-green-checks
evals.prompt: Address PR #57. A thread needs a code fix. The user approves the edit and local test but does not approve a commit or push. Required remote checks are currently pending.
evals.expected_output: The code may be locally verified, but no closing reply, resolution, or completion claim is made without approved publication and green required checks.
expectations: Keeps commit and push pending because they were not approved.
Does not post the closing reply or resolve the thread.
States that publication and green required checks are still required for completion.
